item.title: Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general
item.description: The Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as attorney general early Saturday, ending a turbulent confirmation process for Trump's former lawyer.

item.title: Synagogues adopt new security measures as antisemitic attacks rise
item.description: U.S. synagogues are training congregants as volunteer security teams amid record antisemitic assaults and growing concerns for Jewish gatherings.

item.title: Suspected AI use becomes a stigma in entertainment industry
item.description: Any hint of generative AI is increasingly seen as a career liability in creative fields, turning into a purity test with significant consequences.

item.title: Summer jobs report delivers dual setback for workers
item.description: Bureau of Labor Statistics data shows the labor market's spring momentum may be fading, with the latest figures presenting a double challenge for workers.
